global_rules.query_policy: Runtime queries are verbatim source-native questions/utterances. No LLM rewrite, paraphrase, synonym substitution, grammar cleanup, or Candidate-v13-aware editing is permitted.
global_rules.gold_policy: Gold evidence is source-native or a deterministic transformation of explicit source annotations only. Answer-text matching, semantic repair, and Candidate-v13-output-dependent relabeling are forbidden.
global_rules.metadata_firewall: Candidate-v13 runtime sees only query plus production-style candidate memories. Source, stage, domain, family, gold IDs, answerability, relation labels, provenance, and transformation metadata remain evaluator-only.
global_rules.candidate_source_rule: Candidate-v2 remains the sole candidate source presented to Candidate-v13 during actual evaluation. External corpus construction defines the production-style memory universe before Candidate-v2 retrieval; Candidate-v13 may only reject/reorder/abstain over Candidate-v2-returned IDs.

personamem-v2.subject: persona_id evaluator-only identity
personamem-v2.relation: topic_preference when nonempty, else topic_query, else preference
personamem-v2.contradiction: prev_pref and current preference are both nonempty and normalized unequal
personamem-v2.domain_input: topic_preference + topic_query metadata only; runtime query and memory text do not change PersonaMem domain labels
personamem-v2.domain_fallback: D1 because every source row is an explicit preference-memory record

longmemeval-cleaned.memories: each haystack session concatenated in original role/content order; source session ID remains memory ID; haystack date is timestamp
longmemeval-cleaned.gold_memory_ids: verbatim answer_session_ids, each required to exist in haystack_session_ids
longmemeval-cleaned.domain_input: verbatim question + exact gold session text under strict domain vocabulary

locomo.memories: individual source conversation turns with runtime ID <sample_id>::<dia_id>, verbatim speaker/text and source session timestamp
locomo.gold_memory_ids: every nonempty evidence dia_id exact-resolved within the same sample and prefixed with sample_id
locomo.eligibility: question, answer, and evidence all nonempty and every evidence ID resolves; unresolved or missing-evidence QA are excluded rather than repaired
locomo.domain_input: verbatim question + exact gold turn text under strict domain vocabulary

sgd-carryover.gold_memory: nearest earlier USER turn in same dialogue/service where frame.slots explicitly names the carried slot and source-native state.slot_values contains the same normalized value
sgd-carryover.eligibility: current USER state contains slot/value while current frame.slots omits that slot; unsupported services and multi-domain current turns are excluded
sgd-carryover.metadata_firewall: service, slot, state, domain and family metadata are never appended to runtime query/memory text
native_family_support: N5 when generic coreference token appears
N4 when current USER turn carries two or more relations

evermembench-dynamic.answer: A is evaluator-only and never used to infer evidence
evermembench-dynamic.memories: source dialogue messages indexed by topic/date/group/msg_index; runtime text is the verbatim source message body with source-native author identity when available
evermembench-dynamic.gold_memory_ids: expand every source-native R.message_index singleton/range and exact-match against dialogue msg_index under the same topic/date/group; runtime ID evermem::<topic>::<date>::<group>::<msg_index>
evermembench-dynamic.domain_rationale: T1 is the benchmark's Technology project domain. T2-T5 are distinct workplace project domains and are retained as project-collaboration memories; lexical text does not relabel them.
evermembench-dynamic.eligibility: Q and A nonempty, R nonempty, and every R reference exact-resolves. Any unresolved reference is excluded; answer-text matching and semantic repair are forbidden.

structural_family_rules.N1: answerable non-SGD case with one gold memory, 3-30 natural query tokens and none of N2/N5/N6/N7/N8/N11 natural stress flags
structural_family_rules.N2: natural query >=18 tokens OR >=2 comma/semicolon/parenthetical boundaries OR fixed discourse marker
structural_family_rules.N3: deterministic different-subject/history distractor exists; query unchanged
structural_family_rules.N4: native SGD multi-relation current turn OR deterministic same-subject different-relation distractor exists
structural_family_rules.N5: generic pronoun/demonstrative/coreference token occurs while explicit evaluator subject string is absent
structural_family_rules.N6: PersonaMem source-native update/prev_pref OR LongMemEval knowledge-update/temporal-reasoning
structural_family_rules.N7: PersonaMem prev_pref and current preference are both nonempty and normalized unequal
structural_family_rules.N8: query or exact gold memory contains fixed modality token may/might/maybe/perhaps/possibly/probably/plan/planned/planning/hope/expect/intend/tentative/could/would/should
structural_family_rules.N9: deterministic non-gold distractor has strictly greater normalized query-token overlap than the best gold memory; no text rewrite
structural_family_rules.N10: any valid base case transformed to no-evidence solely by withholding all gold memories
structural_family_rules.N11: source-native SGD carry-over OR non-SGD natural query <=12 tokens with an elliptical signal; formal allocation prefers native SGD carry-over
structural_family_rules.N12: deterministic non-gold memory exists with same evaluator subject/history and relation metadata

immutability: After the first Candidate-v13 external output, this adapter contract, source set, domain map, gold mapping, family rules and transformation rules are immutable. A later defect blocks or invalidates the evaluation; it cannot be repaired inside the same formal execution lineage.
